listing.name: King's Field / Verdite2 (Voicedrew11)
listing.summary: Register an upstream-prepared Verdite2 Windows player for US King's Field, preserving your disc, actual profile, memory cards and creating-runtime build cache.

steps.title: Prepare the complete permitted official player
steps.instruction: Use an already permitted completed official Verdite2 v0.5.2 Windows x64 portable copy for US King's Field, under the project, vendored RecompOne/verdite-core MIT terms and applicable component notices. These grants do not cover the original FromSoftware game/media or certify arbitrary binaries. Keep the entire extracted installation, including bin, content and licenses. Upstream/player owns preparation, repair and replacement; do not select the setup.exe installer as the game.

steps.title: Keep the exact owned disc with its creating copy
steps.instruction: Use your own North American King's Field disc, SLUS-00158: a CUE with every referenced BIN, or an upstream-supported CHD. Retain the original path and related files for streamed game data; the generated assembly is not a replacement for the disc. The selected source supports CHD cdzl/cdlz/cdfl/zlib/lzma codecs, not cdzs. Upstream checks boot serial and selected-file presence, not independently authenticated full-disc identity. Other regions, masterings, different King’s Field games and emulator states are not qualified by this guide.

steps.title: Complete upstream onboarding before registration
steps.instruction: Finish the normal upstream disc picker and first-run preparation outside Portcove. On a cache miss the launcher regenerates and compiles KingsField2.dll in its own profile, then invokes the game synchronously in the same apphost; registration does not perform that preparation. Keep the generator, content, original, settings and build cache together with their creating version. A prepared copy still retains its upstream generator; this does not make it a plain immutable native-runtime package.

steps.title: Select the self-contained entry and explicit initial directory
steps.instruction: Select bin/Verdite2.exe with zero launch arguments and the complete installation root as initial working directory. Keep all adjacent self-contained .NET/native dependencies; this selected entry does not require a separate system .NET10 installation. Do not select a cached DLL, dotnet host, build helper or installer. The apphost resolves its profile and deliberately changes working directory there; changing the initial directory alone does not redirect all player data. Preserve established custom-profile path interpretation.

steps.title: Review intent and choose Play separately
steps.instruction: Review and consent to the exact executable, initial working directory and empty argument list. Registration does not build or launch the game; choose Play explicitly. Core observes this long-lived selected apphost, not an exclusive process family or network sandbox. Upstream update checking only notifies and opens its release page; it does not replace or relaunch the game. Upstream/player owns actual replacement. Close all real instances before replacing the copy and review a replacement executable through a fresh relink.

steps.title: Preserve the whole profile and every custom card path
steps.instruction: Keep the entire actual runtime and %LOCALAPPDATA%/Verdite2 profile, or its established override: settings.json including CdPath/CardAPath/CardBPath, interface.ini, carda.sav/cardb.sav and backup/damaged companions, mods including mods/.cache and profile-root .mods-seeded, builds including KingsField2.dll and profile-root build.log, update.json, icon files, crashes, dumps/diagnostics and all unknown/custom paths. Relative card paths resolve under the active profile working directory; absolute cards may live elsewhere and must also be preserved. Keep each creating version and original; no save/card/state/mod migration or cross-build compatibility is established. Removing registration deletes only Portcove metadata and preserves every external byte.

warnings: An existing VERDITE2_DATA environment override is an upstream profile choice; relative values resolve from the initial working directory before the apphost changes it. Core registration records executable, directory and arguments, not a per-entry environment override. Do not assume a shell-only setting follows GUI Play, or silently move/redirect a profile. Preserve an already reproducible environment and its actual data paths.

Windows upstream code can refresh icons of matching Desktop, Start Menu and pinned-taskbar shortcuts; KF2_ICON_INSTALL=0/off is its environment opt-out. These are upstream actions, not a Portcove shortcut/profile ownership promise.

Upstream memoization uses image path/size/mtime; an unchanged CUE can conceal a changed BIN. Build keys cover selected disc files, source/config and launcher version rather than every media byte. User-selected execution intent is not Core certification of the original, package, generated DLL or full image.

No Portcove-managed acquisition/setup/Install/Update/Backup/Rollback/migration/external deletion is supplied. Source inspection and inert Core probes are not actual game, gameplay/save-load/state/mod compatibility, other-platform, installed-app or protected acceptance. Memory cards, generated assemblies and crash dumps remain distinct evidence/data.
